selection.objective: Macro average of per-view pixel average precision on four positive synthetic scenarios, equal weighting per category and scenario
selection.candidate_order: first in registered cartesian order for ties within 1e-12
selection.cost: Run one 12-epoch predictor on leaf layer, score all 24 candidates without additional training; two validation views per held-out object; confirmation repeats predictor at seeds 42, 43, 44, paired against v1 A4

execution_budget: Confirm Bird first. Proceed in order with a 40 GiB free-space reserve before staging each new archive. Keep all actual runs. Exploratory comparison follows candidate freeze.
